summary: Comprehensive backend+frontend testing of NexusOS SME platform foundation. 21/21 pytest backend tests passed covering auth, dashboard, org isolation, CRUD for customers/products/expenses/tasks, invoice create+pay+status filter, stock movement stock update, settings persistence. Frontend Playwright E2E covered login (demo + form), dashboard KPIs, session persistence on reload, all 12 sidebar nav routes, customer CRUD with validation, workspace switcher (3 workspaces, data changes on switch), theme toggle, currency selector, notifications drawer, logout + protected-route redirect, invoice modal (customer combobox, product line item with live total $226.80, save, mark-paid, all tab filters), inventory stock movement modal, tasks kanban columns todo/in_progress/done + create task, settings tabs (business/profile/preferences/invoicing).

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby (a11y warning in console). Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription to invoice/CRUD modals to remove Radix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py delete_invoice does not cascade payments back into dashboard stats history-wise (deletes payments — correct). No issue.

make_crud PUT does not enforce org_id in fetched result after update (find_one without org_id filter). Not a security issue since matched_count already checks org, but for consistency query with org_id in final find_one.

CORSMiddleware uses allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' from env — browsers reject wildcard with credentials. Frontend still works because Bearer token is used, but the httpOnly cookie flow will fail in browsers. Consider setting CORS_ORIGINS to explicit frontend URL for production.
seed._admin does not re-seed workspaces if admin exists — good idempotency; only re-hashes password on change.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing seeded 3-workspace admin data). Test artifacts created during CRUD tests are cleaned up by same tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend API is fully green. Frontend uses Bearer token from localStorage 'bmp_token'. Invoice customer/product selectors are Radix comboboxes (BUTTON tag), not native SELECT — use force click + role=option. Movement modal uses native SELECT in tested viewport. save-profile/save-preferences testids only render after switching to those tabs in Settings. Multi-tenant isolation verified: org1 vs org2 customers are disjoint sets.
